meta_title: Jones and Sons Plastering | Plasterer Manchester
meta_description: Jones and Sons Plastering in Manchester. Expert internal and external plastering, skimming, and rendering. Fast, reliable service. Call 07506 729673 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From cracked walls to full renovations, we deliver smooth, professional finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: Whether you need internal skimming, external rendering, or specialist repairs, we handle every project with precision and care.

services.title: Internal Skimming & Finishing
services.desc: Smooth, professional skimming on plasterboard and old walls. Perfect for refreshing tired rooms or preparing surfaces for decoration.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external render in sand and cement, acrylic, or polymer finishes. Protects your property and enhances curb appeal.

services.title: Plaster Repairs & Patching
services.desc: Quick fixes for cracks, holes, and damaged plaster. We blend repairs seamlessly so they're invisible once decorated.

services.title: Textured Coatings & Artex
services.desc: Application of textured finishes and decorative coatings. Covers imperfections and adds character to ceilings and walls.

services.title: Damp-Proof Rendering
services.desc: Specialist damp-resistant render systems to protect your home from moisture penetration and improve interior conditions.

services.title: New Build & Renovation Plastering
services.desc: Full plastering on new builds, extensions, and major refurbishments. We work to building regulations and finish to show-home standard.

about_pullquote: We turn rough walls into smooth surfaces homeowners are proud of.
about_para_1: Jones and Sons Plastering has been transforming Manchester homes for over 20 years. Started by two brothers with a commitment to honest workmanship, we've grown from a two-man operation into a trusted team of skilled plasterers. Every member carries the same attention to detail and reliability that built our reputation.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, quote fairly, and finish on time. We don't rush jobs or cut corners—a good plaster coat takes patience and skill, and that's what you get every time. From terraced houses to listed buildings, apartment blocks to new extensions, we've earned the trust of Manchester families and contractors alike.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had my entire downstairs skimmed and they made a brilliant job of it. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished ahead of schedule. Highly recommend Jones and Sons.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: External rendering on our 1970s bungalow needed doing badly. They quoted honestly, used quality materials, and the finish looks immaculate. Great value for money and no mess left behind.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Called them on a Friday for a quote on damp repairs. They came out same day, explained the problem clearly, and started work the following Monday. Very refreshing to deal with a plastering firm that doesn't leave you hanging about.
reviews.author: Paul H.
